title: inDrop
scope: Klein 2015 inDrop implementation of the assigned Illumina hydrogel-barcode schematic. The primary image and the inDrop rows of both posters depict the same target. Hydrogel-bound DNA primers are photo-released for in-droplet RT; barcoded cDNA-derived products carry the transcript readout. Adjacent Hi-SCL, DR-Seq and Nuc-Seq rows are outside scope; CEL-Seq is a downstream preparation component. The graph follows primary-resolved co-encapsulation and emulsion handling while preserving the different drawn account in Corrections.
